title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Mixed Berries 10ml E-Liquid
description: Mixed Berries from the JNP Bar Salts collection offers a rich, highly concentrated, and perfectly balanced fruit medley. The profile weaves together a variety of deep, dark, and jammy summer berries, providing a complex sweetness with subtle tart undertones. Rather than relying on a single dominant note, this blend delivers a robust and continuously engaging flavour journey from the first draw to the last. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the rich fruit notes of Mixed Berries, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the crisp Fresh Mint or the layered Kiwi Passionfruit Guava.
